## Source shape

Describe the score or observation format you want Decision-PGA to accept.

## Candidate labels

What fixed decisions, labels, actions, or routes do the observations score?

## Privacy note

Please use synthetic, public, or anonymized payloads only. Do not include
credentials, private documents, patient data, or sensitive provider responses.

## Desired diagnostic use

What should an agent or workflow do with the resulting diagnostic?
